the reliability of data obtained by core biopsies in breast cancer patients is not the same for all tumor sizes and that a higher number of core biopsies is recommended in larger tumors.

the reliability of the results of core biopsy for ER, PR, Ki67, c-erbB-2 and p53.
the study of the expression of the estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor PR), MIB-1, p53, c-erbB-2 and the Ki-67 index in breast cancer core biopsies and in surgical specimens.
the study of the biopathological profile of breast cancer and the reliability of core biopsy in determining this profile.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
core biopsy is an acceptable method for breast cancer management in small tumors.
the core biopsy is not always a reliable method for the evaluation of the biopathological profile of the breast cancer.
core biopsy results are reliable in pT1 breast cancers but not in p T2 cases, and that the results are not reliable in larger tumors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
core biopsies have a good probability for reliable data for pT1 tumors and a low probability for bigger tumors.
in pT1 tumors, the results of ER,PR, p53 and erbB2 are reliable and in pT2 group, ER and PR are reliable and p53 and erb B2 are reliable but MIB1 is not.

core biopsy is not a valid method for biopathologic evaluation of breast cancer.
